links.outcome: Readability of LLM responses to public mental health questions against sixth-grade standard
links.effect: No model met the sixth-grade readability standard; Claude Sonnet 4.5 was relatively most readable and Claude Sonnet 4.5 Think had the highest reading difficulty.
links.quote: No model met the sixth-grade readability standard; Claude Sonnet 4.5 generated relatively more readable responses, whereas Claude Sonnet 4.5 Think produced responses with the highest reading difficulty.

links.outcome: Spontaneous source transparency of LLM responses (JAMA benchmark scores)
links.effect: Spontaneous source transparency was poor across models, with median JAMA scores of 0.

screen.reason: Evaluates and benchmarks multiple commercial LLMs on public mental health information quality, readability, and empathy using a fixed set of 48 queries without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
